messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Annotation query
parts:
Hi Mark,

The error message is a bit misleading, but the associated warnings "The 2 combined objects have no sequence levels in common." are more informative. 

It means there are no chromosomes in common between your differential regions and the annotation. This is often the case if different chromosome naming styles (ensemble, ucsc) are used. You can use the [seqlevelsStyle()](https://rdrr.io/bioc/GenomeInfoDb/man/seqlevelsStyle.html) from the GenomeInfoDb package to check and change the chromosome naming style for your GRanges objects.

Best,
Alex

On Friday, September 8, 2023 at 2:03:08 AM UTC+12 Alexander Blume wrote:
Hi Mark,

The error message is a bit misleading, but the associated warnings "The 2 combined objects have no sequence levels in common." are more informative. 

It means there are no chromosomes in common between your differential regions and the annotation. This is often the case if different chromosome naming styles (ensemble, ucsc) are used. You can use the [seqlevelsStyle()](https://rdrr.io/bioc/GenomeInfoDb/man/seqlevelsStyle.html) from the GenomeInfoDb package to check and change the chromosome naming style for your GRanges objects.

Best,
Alex
